b1.speaker: voice
b1.text: You left Harcourt breathing. Unexpected. Somebody upstairs just lost a bet.

b2.speaker: voice
b2.text: Harcourt always loved a dramatic ending. Shame he won't see the final cut.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: Someone who's been watching you for a long time. If you haven't found the tape in 204, go back. Tommy left more behind than a body.

h1.speaker: narration
h1.text: Dial tone. Outside, fireworks open over Barstow like silent muzzle flashes.

t2.speaker: tommy
t2.text: Cassie? ...Cassie, is that you? I can't get the door open. It's getting hot.

t3.speaker: narration
t3.text: The voice cuts out beneath a burst of tape hiss. Then the line goes dead.
